packageRules.description: Group postgres + extension variants — same major cadence.
Never auto-merge majors — on-disk format risk for DBs, behavioural drift for apps.

customManagers.description: Track Forgejo-registry-mirrored images in docker-compose.yml. Each tracked entry needs a `# renovate: datasource=docker depName=meltforce.net/<n>` comment immediately before the `image:` line. Renovate queries the Forgejo registry (not docker.io) for tags — so PR proposals are gated on the image being mirrored. The bump-then-merge flow becomes: mirror-bump in ci-workflows merges -> mirror cron pushes new tag to Forgejo -> next Renovate run opens the app-side PR.
